applyTo: "{app,components}/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}"
---

# Widian Website Experience

- Mobile-first and WCAG 2.2 AA.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; motion cannot carry essential meaning alone.
- Maintain page-specific art direction; do not repeat one SaaS page template everywhere.
- Use approved Widian logo/type/colour tokens.
- Ember is scarce emphasis; verified green is for genuinely verified state.
- The Widian Thread must represent continuity, responsibility, evidence or lifecycle rather than decoration.
- Prefer semantic HTML, server-rendered content and minimal purposeful client JavaScript.
- Reserve media dimensions and protect performance/Core Web Vitals.
- Never depict unavailable product functionality as if it were a real screenshot or interaction.
